name: Fighter Class Passives
description: Give each fighter class a skill decal that is always on, without taking a decal slot, and optionally the full pause-map reveal. Adds its own passive hook to BrgGame.upk; the map reveals also need lid-classpassives.dll - see the readme.
author: KSFA
